name: G-code tools
author: Michał Sarna
description: Postprocessors: numbered lines, and a program without comments.

postprocessors.name: Number the lines (N10, N20, …)
postprocessors.description: For controllers that want line numbers.

postprocessors.name: Remove comments
postprocessors.description: Controllers with a short line buffer do not like comments.
